activity_summary: Master Thwaite kept the Sunday lesson plain and did not number his heads. Mistress Ansell had the book in one hand. You said you would write the sheet after church, not in the pew. Alse put you in the south aisle, as always.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Kept the text plain, and asked only that the pew be left as it was found.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Accepted plain, with the book in one hand.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Showed the south aisle, and kept ink off the pew.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Went in, and left the sheet until after church.

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: The text is plain, and I shall keep it plain

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: I have the book in one hand and the door in the other
